channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Patty Mills | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Patty Mills from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Olgun Uluc on Patty Mills
item.description:
According to ESPN's Olgun Uluc and Pete Hooley on The Marketplace, that idea may be more than just be a distant hope.

“I know at least one team, one large market team, a team that sits in a big market city that has had a conversation with Patty Mills,”

Olgun Uluc on Patty Mills, May 14, 2025. Source: NBL.com.au.

item.title: Steve Nash on Patty Mills
item.description:
Ajayi Browne:Steve Nash says,

“Patty (Mills) is going through a tough stretch — The game is not as clear for him as it normally is… He’ll come out of it.”

Steve Nash on Patty Mills, Mar 21, 2022. Source: Twitter @ajayibrowne.

item.title: Dejounte Murray on Patty Mills
item.description:
Dejounte Murray on what he expects from the crowd Friday when Patty Mills returns to the AT&T Center:

“It better be loud. San Antonio better come out and show their appreciation for him. He was here a long time, he won here and he loves this city a lot, he loves the fans...”

Dejounte Murray on Patty Mills, Jan 20, 2022. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Austin Rivers on Blake Griffin, Patty Mills, Cam Thomas
item.description:
Mike Singer:Austin Rivers on his IG live right now:

“You should've seen the Nets team that we were playing tonight. Patty Mills, Blake Griffin, Cam Thomas were the only ones we knew.”

Austin Rivers on Blake Griffin, Patty Mills, Cam Thomas, Dec 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @msinger.

item.title: Monty Williams on Patty Mills
item.description:
#Suns coachMonty Williams on Patty Mills' spirit:

“If you’re on the other side you want to break his neck. But if you are with him its like man I love that guy. When I used to compete against the #Spurs & he was down there waving that towel I just wanted to go tackle him.”

Monty Williams on Patty Mills, Nov 27, 2021. Source: Twitter @NYPost_Lewis.

item.title: Blake Griffin on James Johnson, Patty Mills, Jevon Carter
item.description:
Kristian Winfield:Blake Griffin on the Nets adding Patty Mills, Jevon Carter, James Johnson and Deandre' Bembry in free agency:

“I thought the front office did a great job of targeting exactly what we needand going out and getting it.”

Blake Griffin on James Johnson, Patty Mills, Jevon Carter, Aug 12, 2021. Source: Twitter @Krisplashed.

item.title: Josh Green on Patty Mills, Joe Ingles
item.description:
“It’s always been a dream of mine as a kid. And also just as far from a development standpoint, just being able to get in games and just feel more comfortable on the court and be around guys like Ben, Joe Ingles Patty Mills and guys like that who have really helped me out and to just grow as a player. I’m really looking forward to it and just looking forward to the offseason in general.”

Josh Green on Patty Mills, Joe Ingles, Jun 18, 2021. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills, Dejounte Murray
item.description:
Tom Orsborn:Pop on resting Murray & Mills at end of a 5-game, 7-day road trip:

“As you can imagine, it takes its toll. We just decided with this increased density in the schedule since the All-Star break we needed to help them stay in good shape.”

Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills, Dejounte Murray, Mar 20, 2021. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: More Pop on Patty Mills
item.description:
More Pop on Patty Mills:

“In a strange sort of way, I’m happy for him. He’s a wonderful human being; much better human being off the court than on the court.”

More Pop on Patty Mills, Aug 24, 2019. Source: Twitter @OlgunUluc.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills
item.description:
CoachGregg Popovich on ex-Blazer G Patty Mills:

“He’s the spiritual leader of the team. He’s energetic all the time. He’s always positive. He coaches the young kids. He’s been a huge key in that regard.”

Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills, Feb 7, 2019. Source: Twitter @kerryeggers.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills
item.description:
Popovich also singled out an-other veteran for his leadership skills.

“Patty Mills has been part of our spirit for a while now,”

Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills, Oct 1, 2018. Source: San Antonio Express-News.

item.title: Aron Baynes on Patty Mills, Brett Brown
item.description:
“We had guys from all over the world. I actually had a comfort factor there, because I had played for Brett Brown for a few years when he was an assistant there, and Patty Mills I had played with since I was 15 (in Australia). So I had a good teammate there. “Just the leadership from the top down, being around the way those guys consistently did it night in and night out, I realized why they’re such a good team and why they’ve been who they are for the last two decades. Their work routine, and everyone is so coachable. From the top down there weren’t any barriers. Everyone bought into the system. It was good to be in there.”

Aron Baynes on Patty Mills, Brett Brown, Oct 29, 2017. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Popovich:

“Last time I checked, Tony is still hurt, so Mills is starting.”

Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills, May 14, 2017. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: David Fizdale on Patty Mills
item.description:
Grizzlies'Dave Fizdale on Patty Mills:

“He plays with incredible energy and competition. I have a ton of respect for that kid.”

David Fizdale on Patty Mills, Mar 23, 2017. Source: Twitter @tom_orsborn.

item.title: Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills
item.description:
Quixem Ramirez:Pop on Mills:

“He came to camp all trim and very aggressive. He made us notice him and that he wanted to be a part of this.”

Gregg Popovich on Patty Mills, Jun 14, 2014. Source: Twitter @quixem.
